_comment: Payment model of the fictitious customer XX with its intake flow (build Q, docs/EXTENSION_AND_GATE_PROOF.md): payments from XX's own payment register ZXX_PAYMENT; the link payment -> request from the standard items DFKKOP (cleared by the payment document AUGBL) to XX's intake through the registry link XX_ITEM_TO_INTAKE (custom field ZZXX_PAYREF = the intake's payment reference) - rendered from the link registry, never written as join text; requests from ZXX_INTAKE (request reference = intake number, feeder reference = the payment reference, source = the feeder's logical system). The link is ambiguous by design (the item carries no feeder system): it is joined in the n:m section only, where every candidate intake is a row of the payment trace. Generated into src/paym of this folder; nothing of the product changes.

CompanyCurrency.verify: not kept in the payment register of XX

TransactionType.verify: not kept in the payment register of XX

Finding.verify: exceptions are read from the product's findings

IsLate.verify: no due time in the payment register of XX

notes: Payment -> intake: the items the payment document cleared (DFKKOP-AUGBL) with XX's payment reference
(custom field ZZXX_PAYREF) joined to the intake by registry link XX_ITEM_TO_INTAKE; one row per payment
and intake - two feeders that reused a reference give two rows (ambiguous by design, never one picked).

ReceivedAt.verify: the intake keeps the date only

TransactionType.verify: not kept in the intake of XX
